## Loading packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(posterior)
source("var-dgp.R")      # make_dgps() objects in truth.rds
```

## Load results

```{r}
sweep_id <- "var-sweep-02"
res_dir  <- file.path("results", sweep_id)
fig_dir  <- file.path("figures", sweep_id)
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

truth  <- readRDS(file.path(res_dir, "truth.rds"))
s      <- truth$settings
dgps   <- truth$dgps
p_grid <- s$p_grid

summarise_fit <- function(f) {
  r <- readRDS(f)
  d <- as_tibble(as.data.frame(r$draws))
  add_cell <- function(x) mutate(x, dgp = r$cell$dgp, rep = r$cell$rep,
                                 model = r$cell$model, p = r$cell$p, .before = 1)
  stable <- d$stable == 1

  r2_cols <- c(grep("^R2B_eq\\[", names(d), value = TRUE), "R2B_mean", "R2B_trace")
  r2 <- map_dfr(r2_cols, function(m) {
    x <- d[[m]]
    tibble(measure   = m,
           prop_stat = mean(stable),
           r2_med    = median(x),
           r2_q05    = unname(quantile(x, 0.05)),
           r2_q95    = unname(quantile(x, 0.95)))
  })

  A_cols <- grep("^A\\[", names(d), value = TRUE)
  idx    <- str_match(A_cols, "^A\\[(\\d+),(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]$")
  coef <- tibble(lag = as.integer(idx[, 2]), row = as.integer(idx[, 3]),
                 col = as.integer(idx[, 4]),
                 est = unname(colMeans(d[A_cols])),
                 q05 = unname(map_dbl(d[A_cols], ~ quantile(.x, 0.05))),
                 q95 = unname(map_dbl(d[A_cols], ~ quantile(.x, 0.95))))

  diag <- tibble(divergences = sum(r$diagnostics$num_divergent),
                 max_rhat    = max(r$summary$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
                 prop_stable = mean(stable),
                 time_s      = round(r$time, 1))

  list(r2 = add_cell(r2), coef = add_cell(coef), diag = add_cell(diag),
       scale = tibble(dgp = r$cell$dgp, rep = r$cell$rep, scale = list(r$scale)),
       rows  = tibble(dgp = r$cell$dgp, rep = r$cell$rep, p = r$cell$p,
                      row_first = r$rows_fit[1], row_last = r$rows_fit[2]))
}

files <- list.files(res_dir, pattern = "_r\\d{2}_.*_p\\d{2}_fit\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
fits  <- map(files, summarise_fit)

r2_summary   <- map_dfr(fits, "r2")
coef_summary <- map_dfr(fits, "coef")
diag_tbl     <- map_dfr(fits, "diag")
scales       <- map_dfr(fits, "scale") %>% distinct(dgp, rep, .keep_all = TRUE)
rows_tbl     <- map_dfr(fits, "rows") %>% distinct(dgp, rep, p, .keep_all = TRUE)

length(files)
```

## Labels

```{r}
model_labels <- c(
  normal    = sprintf("Normal (sd = %g)", s$normal$A_sd),
  minnesota = "Minnesota (hierarchical)",
  arr2_flat = sprintf("ARR2 flat (prior R\u00b2 mean %.2g)", s$arr2_flat$mean_R2),
  arr2_minn = sprintf("ARR2 Minn. (prior R\u00b2 mean %.2g)", s$arr2_minn$mean_R2)
)
dgp_labels <- map_chr(dgps[s$dgps], ~ sprintf("%s (true p = %d)", .x$name, .x$p))

label_model   <- function(m) factor(model_labels[m], levels = model_labels)
label_dgp     <- function(g) factor(dgp_labels[g], levels = dgp_labels)
label_measure <- function(m) {
  lab <- case_when(
    str_detect(m, "^R2B_eq") ~ paste("Equation", str_match(m, "\\[(\\d+)\\]")[, 2]),
    m == "R2B_mean"          ~ "Mean across equations",
    m == "R2B_trace"         ~ "Trace"
  )
  fct_relevel(factor(lab), "Mean across equations", "Trace", after = Inf)
}

dgp_p_true <- tibble(dgp = s$dgps, p_true = map_int(dgps[s$dgps], "p")) %>%
  mutate(dgp_lab = label_dgp(dgp))
```

## True values on the standardized scale

```{r}
std_dgp <- function(g, sc) {
  D_inv <- diag(1 / sc, length(sc))
  D     <- diag(sc, length(sc))
  list(A     = map(dgps[[g]]$A, ~ D_inv %*% .x %*% D),
       Sigma = D_inv %*% dgps[[g]]$Sigma %*% D_inv)
}

truth_std <- scales %>%
  mutate(std = map2(dgp, scale, std_dgp))

sim_std <- function(g, r) {
  Y    <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path("simdata", sweep_id, sprintf("%s_r%02d.csv", g, r)),
                             header = FALSE))
  Y_tr <- Y[seq_len(s$T_train), , drop = FALSE]
  sweep(sweep(Y, 2, colMeans(Y_tr)), 2, apply(Y_tr, 2, sd), "/")
}

true_bayes_r2 <- function(A, Sigma, Y, rows) {
  stopifnot(min(rows) > length(A))
  fit <- Reduce(`+`, imap(A, function(Ai, i) Y[rows - i, , drop = FALSE] %*% t(Ai)))
  v   <- apply(fit, 2, var)
  s2  <- diag(Sigma)
  r2_eq <- v / (v + s2)
  tibble(measure = c(sprintf("R2B_eq[%d]", seq_along(v)), "R2B_mean", "R2B_trace"),
         r2_true = c(r2_eq, mean(r2_eq), sum(v) / (sum(v) + sum(s2))))
}

r2_truth <- rows_tbl %>%
  left_join(select(truth_std, dgp, rep, std), by = c("dgp", "rep")) %>%
  group_by(dgp, rep) %>%
  mutate(Y = list(sim_std(first(dgp), first(rep)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(r2 = pmap(list(std, Y, row_first, row_last, p), function(t, Y, a, b, p)
    true_bayes_r2(t$A, t$Sigma, Y, (a + p):b))) %>%
  select(dgp, rep, p, r2) %>%
  unnest(r2)

coef_truth <- truth_std %>%
  mutate(A = map(std, "A")) %>%
  select(dgp, rep, A)
```

```{r}
diag_tbl %>%
  filter(divergences > 0 | max_rhat > 1.01 | prop_stable < 0.99) %>%
  arrange(dgp, model, p) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## Posterior R2 by lag order and DGP

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
r2_plot_df <- r2_summary %>%
  filter(rep == min(rep)) %>%
  mutate(model_lab = label_model(model), dgp_lab = label_dgp(dgp),
         measure_lab = label_measure(measure))

r2_truth_df <- r2_truth %>%
  filter(rep == min(rep)) %>%
  mutate(dgp_lab = label_dgp(dgp), measure_lab = label_measure(measure))

p_r2_trace <- r2_plot_df %>%
  filter(measure == "R2B_trace") %>%   # the quantity ARR2 targets
  ggplot(aes(p, r2_med, colour = model_lab, fill = model_lab)) +
  geom_vline(data = dgp_p_true, aes(xintercept = p_true),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(data = filter(r2_truth_df, measure == "R2B_trace"),
            aes(p, r2_true), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = r2_q05, ymax = r2_q95), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ dgp_lab, nrow = 2, labeller = label_wrap_gen(16)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p",
       y = expression("Posterior Bayesian " * R[trace]^2),
       colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Posterior Bayesian trace R-squared by lag order and DGP",
       subtitle = "Median and 90% band; dashed: true Bayesian R2; dotted: true lag order") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_r2_trace
```

```{r}

#| fig-height: 9
p_r2_measures <- r2_plot_df %>%
```

## Coefficient RMSE against the truth

```{r}
coef_err <- coef_summary %>%
  nest(coefs = c(lag, row, col, est, q05, q95)) %>%
  left_join(coef_truth, by = c("dgp", "rep")) %>%
  mutate(err = pmap(list(coefs, A, p), function(coefs, A, p) {
    N      <- nrow(A[[1]])
    p_true <- length(A)
    expand_grid(lag = seq_len(max(p, p_true)), row = seq_len(N), col = seq_len(N)) %>%
      mutate(truth = pmap_dbl(list(lag, row, col), function(l, i, j)
        if (l <= p_true) A[[l]][i, j] else 0)) %>%
      left_join(select(coefs, lag, row, col, est), by = c("lag", "row", "col")) %>%
      mutate(est = replace_na(est, 0))
  })) %>%
  select(dgp, rep, model, p, err) %>%
  unnest(err)

set_levels <- c("All fitted coefficients", "True nonzero coefficients",
                "True zero coefficients")

rmse_tbl <- bind_rows(
  coef_err %>% filter(lag <= p)               %>% mutate(set = set_levels[1]),
  coef_err %>% filter(truth != 0)             %>% mutate(set = set_levels[2]),
  coef_err %>% filter(truth == 0, lag <= p)   %>% mutate(set = set_levels[3])
) %>%
  group_by(dgp, rep, model, p, set) %>%
  summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((est - truth)^2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(dgp, model, p, set) %>%
  summarise(rmse = mean(rmse), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(set = factor(set, levels = set_levels),
         model_lab = label_model(model), dgp_lab = label_dgp(dgp))

rmse_tbl %>%
  filter(set == set_levels[1]) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(dgp, p), names_from = model, values_from = rmse) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !p, ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8
p_rmse <- rmse_tbl %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, rmse, colour = model_lab)) +
  geom_vline(data = dgp_p_true, aes(xintercept = p_true),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  facet_grid(set ~ dgp_lab, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_wrap_gen(16)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(p_grid), max(p_grid), by = 2)) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p", y = "RMSE of posterior-mean coefficients",
       colour = NULL,
       title = "Coefficient RMSE against the truth by lag order and DGP",
       subtitle = "Standardized scale; dotted: true lag order") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_rmse
```

## Estimated coefficients against the truth

```{r}
p_show <- max(p_grid)

coef_label <- function(row, col) {
  ifelse(row == col, sprintf("y%d on own lags", row), sprintf("y%d on lags of y%d", row, col))
}

coef_plot_df <- coef_summary %>%
  filter(p == p_show, rep == min(rep)) %>%
  mutate(model_lab = label_model(model), coef_lab = coef_label(row, col))

coef_truth_df <- coef_truth %>%
  filter(rep == min(rep)) %>%
  mutate(tr = map(A, function(A) {
    N <- nrow(A[[1]])
    expand_grid(lag = seq_len(p_show), row = seq_len(N), col = seq_len(N)) %>%
      mutate(truth = pmap_dbl(list(lag, row, col), function(l, i, j)
        if (l <= length(A)) A[[l]][i, j] else 0))
  })) %>%
  select(dgp, tr) %>%
  unnest(tr) %>%
  mutate(coef_lab = coef_label(row, col))

plot_coefs <- function(g) {
  ggplot(filter(coef_plot_df, dgp == g),
         aes(lag, est, colour = model_lab)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95),
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = filter(coef_truth_df, dgp == g), aes(lag, truth),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 4, size = 2.5, stroke = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ coef_lab, ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(p_show)) +
    labs(x = "Lag", y = "Coefficient (standardized scale)", colour = NULL,
         title = sprintf("Estimated coefficients against the truth: %s", dgp_labels[g]),
         subtitle = sprintf("Fitted with p = %d; posterior mean and 90%% interval; x: true value",
                            p_show)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

p_coefs <- map(set_names(s$dgps), plot_coefs)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
walk(p_coefs, print)
```

## Save figures

```{r}
source("../slide-theme.R")   # slide versions (larger text, no titles) for the presentation
save_slide(p_r2_trace, file.path(fig_dir, "var_post_r2_trace_by_dgp.png"), height = 6.5, base_size = 16)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "var_post_r2_measures_by_dgp.png"), p_r2_measures, width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 150)
save_slide(p_rmse, file.path(fig_dir, "var_coef_rmse_by_dgp.png"), height = 6.5, base_size = 16)
iwalk(p_coefs, ~ ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("var_coefs_p%02d_%s.png", p_show, .y)),
                        .x, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 150))
```
